bullets: Built an event-ingestion service in Go handling 40k messages per second, replacing a batch job that ran four hours behind real time.
Designed an append-only PostgreSQL ledger as the source of truth for account balances, integrating consumption across three pipelines without disrupting billing or rate limiting.
Audited customer and billing flows to identify 20+ production defects including concurrent-write bugs and unauthenticated handlers; shipped fixes with regression coverage.
Implemented vector search over 12M documents with FAISS, cutting median retrieval latency from 800ms to 45ms.
Shipped a multi-stage ETL pipeline on Cloud Run with stateless workers and auto-scaling sized for 5x projected load.
